> An open-source 16-bit discrete processor architecture designed from logic gates and standard components. Features custom 16-bit instruction encoding, dual general-purpose registers, condition flags (Zero and Carry), and a fully simulated 16-bit ALU capable of arithmetic and bitwise logic operations.
